Gombe State governor, Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya, has donated ₦10 million to families of three persons killed in a shooting incident in Lawanti community, Akko Local Government Area, while promising a thorough investigation and justice for the victims. Yahaya made the donation during a visit to the community following an alleged shooting involving military personnel that left three persons dead and 13 others injured. LEADERSHIP had earlier reported that the incident occurred on Friday, November 20, 2026, following a confrontation between military personnel and residents over the suspected theft of armoured cables. During the visit, the governor assured residents that his administration would work with relevant authorities to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident and ensure accountability. Yahaya, who was accompanied by the APC governorship candidate, Jamil Isyaku Gwamna, and other government officials, met with the affected families at the palace of the District Head of Lawanti. The meeting was also attended by the Lamido Gona, Alhaji Umar Abdulkadir Abdussalam. The governor expressed sorrow over the loss of lives and extended his condolences to the bereaved families and the entire community. Of the ₦10 million donated, ₦6 million was allocated to the three families that lost relatives, with each family receiving ₦2 million. The remaining ₦4 million was earmarked for the community leadership, youths and women. Yahaya also assured residents that his administration would monitor the condition of those still receiving medical treatment and provide necessary assistance. He urged traditional rulers, religious leaders, community elders and other stakeholders to work together to maintain peace and discourage the spread of misinformation and inflammatory statements capable of escalating tensions. The governor reiterated his administration’s commitment to the security and welfare of residents, assuring the community that justice would be pursued and efforts made to strengthen trust between residents and security agencies. Speaking on behalf of the affected families and the community, the Lamido Gona, Alhaji Umar Abdulkadir Abdussalam, thanked the governor for visiting Lawanti and identifying with the victims. He also acknowledged an earlier intervention by a government delegation led by the Secretary to the State Government, Professor Ibrahim Abubakar Njodi, which attended the funeral prayers and met with bereaved families, traditional authorities and community leaders.
